Unknown ([[JN145]]) | java1=[[Chiaki Takahashi]] | }} '''Jessie's Frillish''' (Japanese: '''ムサシのプルリル''' ''Musashi's Pururill'') is the second Pokémon that [[Jessie]] obtained in the [[Unova]] region, and her ninth overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|BW}}=== [[File:Jessie and Frillish.png|thumb|left|250px|Frillish and Jessie]] Jessie's Frillish first appeared in ''[[BW109|New Places... Familiar Faces!]]'', debuting along with [[James's Amoonguss]] when {{TRT}} attacked {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} for the first time since their Operation Tempest and temporary retreat back to [[Kanto]]. When Ash and friends were helping [[Nanette]] gain some experience, Team Rocket surprised them, sent out their new Pokémon, and used a combination of Mist and {{m|Stun Spore}} on them and their Pokémon, reducing the visibility to almost nothing and paralyzing [[Iris's Emolga]] and [[Cilan's Stunfisk]] at the same time, thus leaving Ash alone to face Team Rocket with {{AP|Pikachu}}. After Amoonguss had successfully knocked Pikachu out, Jessie had {{p|Frillish}} use Psychic, lifting Pikachu into the air and towards Team Rocket's {{TP|Team Rocket|mecha|mechas}}. However, thanks to the distraction provided by Nanette and her {{p|Tepig}}, Pikachu was freed, although Tepig got caught in the process. For a getaway distraction, Team Rocket fired a combination of Bubble Beam and {{m|Hidden Power}}, which, much to their surprise, was endured by [[Ash's Unfezant]], followed by an {{m|Air Cutter}} and an {{m|Aerial Ace}} to defeat Frillish and Amoonguss. In ''[[BW110|The Name's N!]]'', Jessie sent Frillish out after catching Pikachu. She distracted Ash from holding on to his {{AP|Snivy}} when Snivy used {{m|Vine Whip}} to grab onto their balloon. Frillish once again battled Unfezant and used Bubble Beam on her, but Unfezant dodged and used {{m|Aerial Ace}} to free Pikachu. Pikachu joined in the battle and tried to finish off Team Rocket with {{m|Thunderbolt}}, but Amoonguss's Stun Spore paralyzed him before the attack completely blasted them off. Frillish was taken out along with Amoonguss by Unfezant's {{m|Air Cutter}} which slammed them into Team Rocket's balloon causing it to be blasted away. [[File:Jessie Frillish saving Meowth.png|thumb|250px|Frillish saving Meowth from Team Plasma]] After Team Plasma took control of Meowth with their machine in ''[[BW119|Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!]]'', Jessie and James decided to attack their friend in order to get him out of the trance. After Amoonguss used {{m|Stun Spore}} to paralyze Meowth and {{m|Body Slam}} to incapacitate him, Frillish brought Meowth back to Jessie and James with Psychic. Having Meowth out of Team Plasma's control, Team Rocket managed to get out of their headquarters using Frillish's Mist. In ''[[BW141|Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!]]'', Frillish battled Ash and {{ashfr}} for the final time in Unova. Working with Amoonguss, the two threw Ash, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} into the cruise ship's cargo hold, giving Team Rocket the time to steal all of the [[Poké Ball]]s on the ship. Right as they were about to make their escape, [[Ash's Charizard]] appeared and made quick work of them with {{m|Flamethrower}}. Frillish was given away to {{an|Giovanni}} for Team Rocket in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]''. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'', Frillish, alongside the rest of Team Rocket's Pokémon at {{an|Team Rocket HQ}}, were sent to Jessie and James so they could be added back to their team. Realizing the potential of such a large group, the team hatched a scheme to isolate Ash's Pikachu and capture him. Frillish and {{TP|James|Yamask}} were the second to do so, distracting {{an|Misty}} and her Pokémon while Ash and Pikachu ran ahead. Upon getting a distress signal from {{TP|Jessie|Gourgeist}}, the two returned to their Trainers to take on Pikachu as a group. She joined all of Team Rocket to launch a combined attack at the Mouse Pokémon. However, it was dodged, and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} ended up sending it back with {{m|Mirror Coat}}. A wild {{an|Latias}} that had been following Ash then intervened and sent the evil group blasting off. ==Personality and characteristics== In contrast to James's Amoonguss, Frillish was considered to be more mischievous in the group. She had little trouble following Jessie's commands, as shown when she used Psychic to lift up anything. Similar to Jessie's previous Pokémon, Frillish's Mist was proven to be very effective as a way for Team Rocket to retreat. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|water|ghost|Jessie Frillish {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Mist|1=Psychic|2=BubbleBeam|3=Shadow Ball}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Mist|1=Psychic|2=Bubble Beam|3=Shadow Ball}}}} {{anmov|ice|Mist|BW109|New Places... Woobat launches Air Slash, Frillish, Gourgeist and Yamask launch Shadow Ball, Amoonguss and Carnivine launch Energy Ball, Yanmega launches Silver Wind, Inkay launches Psybeam, and Seviper launches Sludge Bomb. The attacks fuse together to create a single massive beam of energy. This was used against {{Ash}}, {{TP|Ash|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Ash|Infernape}}, and {{TP|Ash|Hawlucha}} in Team Rocket's attempt to steal Pikachu, but once they dodged, the attack headed towards Team Rocket. |} ==Trivia== * Not counting temporary Pokémon, Frillish was Jessie's first {{t|Water}} type, as well as her first {{t|Ghost}} type. * Not counting temporary Pokémon or [[Growlie]], who never appeared on James's team, Frillish holds the record for the least appearances out of Team Rocket's Pokémon, at 9 main series episodes. * Frillish is the only non-temporary Pokémon owned by Team Rocket to possess [[List of Pokémon with gender differences|gender differences]] in her debut, as gender differences did not exist when {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} and {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}} were obtained in {{aniseries|PTS}}. * Not counting temporary Pokémon, Frillish was the first of Team Rocket Pokémon to have had a unique [[List of Pokémon with unique type combinations|type combination]]. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Frillish}} {{Team Rocket's Pokémon|water|ghost}} {{Giovanni's Pokémon|water|ghost}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Jessie's Pokémon|Frillish]] [[Category:Giovanni's Pokémon]] [[Category:Female characters (Pokémon)|Frillish]] [[de:Jessies Quabbel]] [[es:Frillish de Jessie]] [[fr:Viskuse de Jessie]] [[it:Frillish di Jessie]] [[ja:ムサシのプルリル]] [[zh:武藏的轻飘飘]]
